arguments.value: 72-year-old man with new behavioral changes, memory loss, seizures, and progressive encephalopathy was found to have CSF inflammation and anti-NR1 antibody positivity, consistent with paraneoplastic anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis. Workup revealed stage IIIB left lung large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma with NR1 expression in tumor tissue and mediastinal nodal metastasis. Neurologic symptoms and tumor burden improved after corticosteroids, IVIG, and radiation therapy.
